one_liner: Unified spend platform with public API and official MCP server.
access_notes: Any Brex customer can enable Developer API and create tokens; MCP access is enabled by an account admin via beta settings.
blocker_notes: Only if REST OAuth Authorization Code is required outside MCP; PAT or MCP builds are not blocked.

evidence.quote: To start making calls to Brex APIs, generate a user token from your Brex dashboard and pass it along in your API call headers.
The Brex MCP server … The server is hosted at https://api.brex.com/mcp … OAuth (recommended) … supports Dynamic Client Registration … [or] API key.
Production: https://api.brex.com … Staging: https://api-staging.brex.com … There are no availability guarantees in staging.
Brex APIs … are defined using the OpenAPI specification…
Accounting, Budgets, Expenses, Fields, Onboarding, Payments, Team, Transactions, Travel, Webhooks
